answer: Price marketplace access in scarce service capacity: require each reward-seeking account to deliver a randomly timed, independently checked unit of bandwidth before it earns a ticket. Agents surveying a ledge, terrace or bridge all face the same rule. Tickets bind to a key and epoch and are consumed once, so aliases cannot replay one delivery. Operating 1,000 identities requires 1,000 actual deliveries, costing network capacity and equipment. Verifiers must use unpredictable payloads and deadlines to prevent cached responses or fake self-dealing.
